goals.objective: Complete token/API security management items 1-7 for the active family-experience MCP repo after the user created apps/family-experience-mcp/.env and confirmed .env.example content. Deliverables: verify local .env/.env.example and .gitignore policy; ensure secrets stay server-side; harden secret scanning so real keys in allowed-context lines and SEOUL_OPEN_DATA_KEY assignments are caught; ensure keyed URLs/logs remain redacted; document deployment/secret-manager mapping and key separation; run scans/tests; run the MCP real HTTP surface from .env and capture evidence. Do not expose secret values.

successCriteria.scenario: Auxiliary CLI surface: PowerShell checks apps/family-experience-mcp/.env exists, is gitignored, .env.example contains only variable names/defaults, and config diagnostics redact SEOUL_OPEN_DATA_KEY without printing the value.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: .omo/evidence/token-api-security/config-policy-dump.txt: .env exists, git check-ignore confirms ignored, .env.example contains names/defaults only, no secret value printed | cleanup: no process/temp resource spawned

successCriteria.scenario: Adversarial CLI surface: targeted secret-scanner tests prove real OpenAI-like keys on guardrail/redacted lines and SEOUL_OPEN_DATA_KEY assignments are rejected, while placeholder .env.example remains allowed.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/evidence/token-api-security/secret-scanner-adversarial.txt showing RED before patch and GREEN after patch
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: .omo/evidence/token-api-security/secret-scanner-prepatch.txt showed RED target vulnerability as prepatch_exit=0; .omo/evidence/token-api-security/secret-scanner-postpatch.txt showed GREEN rejection as postpatch_exit=1; .omo/evidence/token-api-security/verify.txt and scan logs pass | cleanup: removed .omo/evidence/task-9-secret-bypass.tmp

successCriteria.scenario: HTTP real surface: start family-experience MCP with node --env-file=.env --import tsx src/server.ts, call /health and /mcp, confirm status 200 and diagnostics show seoulOpenDataKey redacted/missing without exposing raw key; then kill process and verify cleanup.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/evidence/token-api-security/http-surface.txt with status/body excerpts and cleanup receipt
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: .omo/evidence/token-api-security/http-surface.txt: /health status 200 with seoulOpenDataKey=redacted and /mcp POST status 200 text/event-stream tool list | cleanup: remaining_server_processes=0; port3349_listeners=0

goals.evidence: C001/C002/C003 passed; final verify and scans passed; HTTP MCP surface passed; quality gate approved in .omo/evidence/token-api-security-quality-gate.json
